plas-09-c2.text: H. Abu-Shawareb et al. (The Indirect Drive ICF Collaboration) (2024). Achievement of target gain larger than unity in an inertial fusion experiment. Physical Review Letters 132, 065102.
plas-09-c2.quote: On December 5, 2022, an indirect drive fusion implosion on the National Ignition Facility (NIF) achieved a target gain
plas-09-c2.claim: On December 5, 2022, NIF achieved scientific breakeven

plas-08-c3.text: Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP) (2023). Wendelstein 7-X reaches milestone: Power plasma with gigajoule energy turnover generated for eight minutes. IPP press release.
plas-08-c3.quote: they were able to achieve an energy turnover of 1.3 gigajoules in this device
plas-08-c3.claim: In 2023 it sustained a 480 s plasma with 1.3 GJ of energy turnover
